branches.conclusion: The current Robinson College Ph.D. overview and detailed doctoral-programme inventory were read. They list accounting, digital innovation, information systems, management, marketing and other fields, but no currently named Operations, Management Science or Industrial Engineering doctoral title or specialization. This is limited to the reviewed current Robinson inventory; it does not refute a historical Operations Management PhD.

Opened all four pages of the official current university-wide Ph.D./professional-doctorate finder by its displayed 1–4 pagination, ending with page 4 and no next page. No Operations, Management Science or Industrial Engineering degree/concentration appears. The Computer Science PhD states general/Bioinformatics tracks; the Mathematics and Statistics PhD explicitly lists five concentrations: Machine Learning and Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Mathematics, Bioinformatics and Biostatistics. No separate engineering school is listed in the finder school filter. Current technical doctoral titles do not meet the strict named-title rule.
